text_a: Ana sent the file and Luis the report.
text_b: Ana sent the file, and Luis sent the report.

text_a: María revisó el contrato y Pedro también.
text_b: María revisó el contrato y Pedro revisó el contrato.

text_a: A Rita enviou o relatório e o Tiago a fatura.
text_b: A Rita enviou o relatório e o Tiago também enviou o relatório.
what_differs: Tiago sent the invoice in A, but the report in B

text_a: Tom approved the budget and the schedule.
text_b: Tom approved the budget, and the schedule too.
what_differs: Ambiguous whether 'too' means Tom also approved the schedule or someone else approved it

text_a: The invoice was paid yesterday.
text_b: The invoice was paid the day before today.

text_a: La reunión se movió para el próximo lunes.
text_b: La reunión se movió para este lunes.
what_differs: 'next Monday' vs 'this Monday' may denote different dates depending on the day

text_a: Falámos com o cliente há dois dias.
text_b: Falámos com o cliente anteontem.

text_a: The audit starts next week.
text_b: The audit starts a week from today.
what_differs: 'next week' is a calendar week, 'a week from today' is a specific day

text_a: El manual del usuario incluye un glosario.
text_b: El glosario es parte del manual del usuario.

text_a: The company's laptop must be returned on the last day.
text_b: The laptop belongs to the company and must be returned on the last day.
what_differs: 'company's laptop' may mean company-issued or company-owned; both readings plausible

text_a: A chave do armazém está com o Carlos.
text_b: O Carlos tem a chave do armazém.

text_a: The client's password was reset.
text_b: The password of the client's account was reset by the client.
what_differs: B adds that the client performed the reset

text_a: Provide a phone number if available.
text_b: The phone number field is optional.

text_a: Indique su segundo apellido cuando corresponda.
text_b: El segundo apellido es obligatorio.
what_differs: Conditional/where-applicable vs always mandatory

text_a: Os campos marcados com asterisco são obrigatórios.
text_b: Only fields marked with an asterisk must be filled in.

text_a: Attach a receipt where applicable.
text_b: Attach a receipt if you have one.
what_differs: 'where applicable' depends on the case type, 'if you have one' depends on possession

text_a: Cierra la sesión al terminar.
text_b: La sesión debe cerrarse al terminar.

text_a: Back up the database tonight.
text_b: The database was backed up tonight.
what_differs: Instruction to do vs report that it was done

text_a: O servidor será reiniciado às 22h.
text_b: O servidor deve ser reiniciado às 22h.
what_differs: Announcement of a planned event vs obligation

text_a: The form should be submitted by Friday.
text_b: Submit the form by Friday.
what_differs: 'should' may be a recommendation or a command

text_a: Deployment requires a passing test run.
text_b: Run the tests before deploying, and deploy only if they pass.

text_a: Solo puedes publicar después de que el editor apruebe el texto.
text_b: El editor debe aprobar el texto después de que lo publiques.
what_differs: Order of approval and publication reversed

text_a: A fase dois depende da conclusão da fase um.
text_b: A fase dois só começa depois de a fase um terminar.
what_differs: Dependency may mean data dependency or strict start ordering

text_a: Refunds depend on manager approval.
text_b: Refunds are issued after manager approval.
what_differs: A states a condition, B states sequence without saying approval is necessary to issue

text_a: Se aceptan entre 3 y 5 archivos.
text_b: Se aceptan de 3 a 5 archivos.
what_differs: 'entre' may or may not include endpoints

text_a: Choose at most 5 options.
text_b: Choose up to 5 options.

text_a: Idades de 18 a 25 anos, inclusive.
text_b: Ages 18 through 25.

text_a: Fewer than 5 attempts are allowed.
text_b: Up to 5 attempts are allowed.
what_differs: Maximum is 4 vs 5

text_a: Delete the file from the shared folder.
text_b: Delete a file from the shared folder.
what_differs: Specific known file vs any one file

text_a: Cualquier archivo adjunto debe ser escaneado.
text_b: Todo archivo adjunto debe ser escaneado.

text_a: Abra o mesmo ficheiro e compare.
text_b: Abra esse ficheiro e compare.
what_differs: 'the same file' implies identity with a prior file; 'that file' may be deictic to a different referent

text_a: Upload the same file to both servers.
text_b: Upload a copy of one file to each of the two servers.
what_differs: Identity of the file vs copies; subtle but different

text_a: Los participantes deben firmar cada uno por separado.
text_b: Each participant must sign individually.

text_a: The students will present together.
text_b: The students will each present.
what_differs: Joint presentation vs individual presentations

text_a: As equipas entregam o relatório como grupo.
text_b: Cada equipa entrega um relatório.
what_differs: Could be one report per team (same) or one joint group submission

text_a: Review the tickets one by one.
text_b: Review each ticket separately.

text_a: La puerta permanece abierta durante la prueba.
text_b: La puerta está abierta durante la prueba.
what_differs: 'permanece' implies it was open beforehand and continues; 'está' only states the state

text_a: The valve opens at 80 degrees.
text_b: The valve is opened at 80 degrees.

text_a: A janela foi aberta às 9h.
text_b: The window is open from 9 a.m.
what_differs: Event of opening at 9 vs state of being open since 9 (and no claim of an event)

text_a: The account stays open until you close it.
text_b: The account remains open until closed.
